text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-23456 - gpu-alloc-failures on gpu-prod-12 (eu-west-1)
pagerduty: Triggered by metric rule `cuda.alloc.fail.rate > 5/min` (alerting policy: gpu-ooms) — escalation policy: oncall-sre
alex: acked oncall pagerduty PD-23456 :white_check_mark: looking
alex: seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in agent logs for gpu-prod-12
alex: monitoring snapshot: `nvidia-smi` shows 99% memory, several persistent processes pinned
jon: copying logs: ```[2026-02-12T14:12:03Z] ERROR runtime: cuda alloc failed: 0x7fa3b2c00000 size=268435456 pid=2345 model=gpt-13b quantized
[2026-02-12T14:12:04Z] WARN runtime: prefetch eviction failed, kvcache entries pinned=12432
[2026-02-12T14:12:05Z] ERROR allocator: cuda kernel launch failed: out_of_memory
```
maria: tagging for eng-runtime loop — @jon @deepa can you confirm this is not a spurious metric spike?
jon: confirmed on metrics side — sustained alloc failure count across last 6m, not a blip
jon: also seeing high tail-latency retries hitting fallback paths, customer errors spiking (5xx from inference gateway)
alex: initial customer impact: hosted text-generation customers routed to eu-west-1 experiencing ~2% elevated 500s, some long tail latencies, no complete region outage yet
deepa: starting mitigation: plan A = drain node, migrate pods to other GPU nodes, enable fallback routing to cpu/quantized variant for active sessions
deepa: running drain: `kubectl drain gpu-prod-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
alex: heads-up: if we drain, may cause a short surge in scheduling; enable autoscale on dedicated pools first
maria: I'm taking primary lead for hands-on; alex handoff accepted — maria (eng-runtime) now primary
maria: @pagerduty please escalate to eng-runtime on-call rotation if ack window passes without recovery
pagerduty: Escalation rule: if not resolved in 8m -> notify eng-runtime-team and oncall-manager
jon: to reduce blast radius, I'm publishing a temporary routing rule: route new requests for heavy seq>2048 to model variant `gpt-13b-quant-fallback` in us-west-2 / eu-west-1 fallback pool
jon: command (running): ```routectl apply --match 'seq>2048' --from pool=gpu-prod --to pool=gpu-fallback-quant --ttl=10m```
alex: Maria, what's ETA on drain completion?
maria: drain started, pods evicting, some stuck pods due to mounted volumes — manual delete on stuck pods in flight (doing now)
deepa: while we drain, I'm flipping KV cache aggressive-eviction policy on gpu-prod cluster to free memory: `kvctl set eviction aggressive=true --cluster=gpu-prod`
alex: noted. also increase retry-budget to avoid cascading 429s: `configapi set inference.retry_budget=0.3`
jon: eviction change accepted — watching memory metrics, GPU mem usage dropping from 99% -> 78% over 90s
maria: one large tenant job pinned large tensors, asked to pause job via admin control plane — tenant contact DM'ed and pausing now
alex: customer-impact update: error-rate reduced to ~0.8% from 2% after reroutes and eviction — still under watch but improving
incident-bot: :information_source: Auto-runbook suggestion: `gpu-oom-evacuation-v2` recommended by playbook matcher (confidence 0.87)
deepa: good call, follow runbook step 3 (drain + kv eviction + model fallback). I'll document exact steps for postmortem
maria: any need to preemptively spin up more fallback capacity? we have spare capacity in us-west-2 but cross-region latency consequences for some customers. Recommend enabling burst pool in eu-west-1 (spin up 2 x A10)
alex: approved — spinning up burst workers now, will take ~4m to attach to pool
john: (typo) jon meant to say `jon` above — ignore
jon: :sweat_smile: noted
maria: confirmed node gpu-prod-12 drained and cordoned. Scheduling movers finished. No more allocate failures observed on that node; cluster mem stable
alex: ok handoff: I need to step out for 15m, maria please continue as primary. I'll remain reachable.
maria: ack takeover :handshake: continuing monitoring, will open incident doc and link here
maria: incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-23456 (creating now)
alex: thanks, team. post-incident actions to track: root-cause (why single job pinned memory), improve eviction heuristics for large-tensor tenants, add early-warning metric for kvcache pin growth
maria: closing note — PD-23456 will remain open until 3h of stable metrics; I'll update every 15m in this thread. Next update in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
